capabilities: Create, edit, reorder, and complete tasks in four quadrants
Manage reusable tags and browse completed-task history
Set deadlines with single, daily, or weekly advance reminders
Embed the shared quadrant board in notes via a code block
Open the board from the ribbon, command palette, or hotkey
extras: Interface is in Simplified Chinese. Desktop-only, developed and tested mainly on Windows; macOS, Linux, and mobile are unverified or unsupported. Manual installation (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Tasks are stored in the plugin's data.json, not as Markdown tasks, and no sync service is included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for organizing tasks by importance and urgency or for deadline-based desktop reminders.
summary: Four-quadrant (importance/urgency) task board with reusable tags, deadlines, desktop reminders, completed-task history, and an embeddable board view.
